Meta.title: Solangi Ecommerce — YOUR TRUST IS OUR WEALTH
Meta.description: Shop retail and sell on Solangi Ecommerce. Trusted marketplace for Pakistan.

Announce.delivery: on first retail order over Rs 3,000
Announce.sell: Sell on Solangi — seller applications opening soon
Announce.payments: Payments: Card · JazzCash · EasyPaisa · Bank · COD

Hero.copy: Shop retail today. Sell when you are ready. One trusted marketplace for Pakistan.
Hero.slide2Copy: Seasonal savings across fashion, home, and electronics — priced in PKR, viewable in your currency.
Hero.slide3Copy: Switch modes above. Retail ships first; wholesale, used, and services open as labeled entrances.

Flash.title: Flash sale & offers
Flash.sub: Timed deals on retail listings. Prices update often.

Featured.title: Featured products
Featured.sub: Hand-picked retail picks across Solangi categories.

Trending.title: Trending & best sellers
Trending.sub: What shoppers are buying right now in retail mode.

Join.title: Join Solangi
Join.sub: Five ways to participate. Affiliate, MLM, and Investor stay on holding pages until approved.
Join.customerP: Browse, buy, track orders, and leave reviews.
Join.sellerP: List products and sell — customers buy and sell in MVP.
Join.affiliateP: Program overview only. Engine after compliance.
Join.mlmP: Network marketing explanation. Ranks stay off homepage.
Join.investorP: Information and inquiry path. No return promises.

Why.title: Why choose Solangi
Why.sub: Built around one promise: your trust is our wealth. Short proof points for the retail launch.
Why.1t: Buy and sell in one place
Why.1p: Customers shop retail and can sell — marketplace modes expand from there.
Why.2p: Card, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, bank transfer, and COD — gateways go live after build progress.
Why.3p: Eighteen product categories plus Retail, Wholesale, Used, and Services entrances.
Why.visualPh: Trust marks — photos via admin later

Reviews.title: Customer reviews
Reviews.sub: Sample voices for layout review. Real reviews land with moderation later.
Reviews.r1: Clean shopping experience. I found home goods quickly and checkout felt familiar.
Reviews.r2: As a seller I want listings that update prices easily — this layout already makes that feel possible.
Reviews.r3: Language and currency switches in the header are exactly what multi-city families need.

Footer.tagline: YOUR TRUST IS OUR WEALTH · solangiecommerce.com
Footer.payNote: Marks only — gateways not live yet.

Holding.affiliateBody: This is a holding page. The affiliate engine stays off until compliance and the rate card are approved.
Holding.mlmBody: This is a holding page. Ranks, trees, and commissions are not active on the homepage or in MVP.
Holding.investorBody: Inquiry path only. No public promise or automatic calculation of investment returns.
Holding.sellerBody: Customers can buy and sell in the MVP. Seller registration and store tools ship in the next modules.
Holding.accountBody: Customer login and dashboard come in a later module. Use this entry for buy and sell paths.
Holding.cartBody: Cart and checkout ship in the retail trade module. Demo cart count is for chrome review only.
Holding.modeRetail: Retail (B2C) is the live catalog path for this MVP homepage.
Holding.modeOther: Mode catalogs are live — open Wholesale, Used, or Services from the homepage.

Catalog.categorySub: Browse seed retail listings in this category. Photos are Solangi placeholders until assets arrive.
Catalog.emptyCategory: No retail listings in this category yet.
Catalog.cartNote: Cart is saved on this device. Checkout supports COD first; other gateways later.
Catalog.includesSeller: {count} live seller listing(s) in this category
Catalog.notFoundBody: This item is not in the shop catalog right now.
Catalog.fromSellersSub: Active listings from the seller desk appear here and in their categories.
Catalog.tempIconNote: Temporary category icon — real photos will come from admin later.
Catalog.serviceNote: Service bookings use the same COD checkout for now — confirm details with the provider after order.

Auth.loginSide: Sign in with your phone, then confirm a one-time code. Real SMS OTP wires in when the backend module lands.
Auth.registerSide: Join as a customer to shop — or as a seller to list products. Buy and sell are both part of the MVP.
Auth.verifySide: Enter the 6-digit code to finish sign-in. Demo accepts any 6 digits (try 123456).
Auth.forgotSide: We will send a one-time code to your phone so you can continue securely.
Auth.phoneHint: Pakistan mobile number — OTP will be sent here.
Auth.passwordHint: Optional for now — OTP is the primary gate in this UI module.
Auth.rolesNote: Affiliate, MLM, and Investor stay off auth for MVP — holding pages only.
Auth.verifySent: Code sent to {phone} (simulated until SMS is connected).
Auth.verifyMissing: Start from login or register to receive a code.
Auth.forgotHint: We will open the OTP screen for this number.
Auth.accountGateBody: Sign in or create an account to open your portal. Customer and seller paths start here.
Auth.portalBody: You are signed in as {role}. Next we build this portal module by module — cart, orders, and seller tools.
Auth.portalShopBody: Continue browsing categories and products on the storefront.
Auth.portalSellerBody: Seller tools come next. This opens the seller holding page for now.
Auth.portalBecomeSellerBody: MVP lets customers buy and sell — register a seller profile when ready.
Auth.portalOrdersBody: Checkout and order tracking ship in a later module.
Auth.demoNote: Auth is UI + local demo session only — no live SMS or server yet.

Customer.dashSub: Your customer hub for profile, addresses, orders, and saved items.
Customer.quickProfile: Update name, phone, and contact details.
Customer.profileSub: Keep your contact details current for delivery and support.
Customer.profileNote: Saved locally until the server profile API is connected.
Customer.label: Label
Customer.ordersSub: Demo order history for portal review. Live orders arrive with checkout.
Customer.ordersDemoNote: These are seed orders for UI only — not live transactions.
Customer.wishlistSub: Saved products. Add/remove is stored on this device for now.

Seller.enableBody: You are signed in as a customer. Enable seller mode to open your store desk — MVP supports buy and sell.
Seller.dashSub: Manage {store} — listings, orders, and store profile.
Seller.quickListings: Add or edit products and stock.
Seller.viewShopBody: See how customers browse Solangi retail.
Seller.storeSub: Public store details buyers will see later on your store page.
Seller.slugHint: Letters and dashes only — e.g. my-solangi-store
Seller.storeNote: Saved on this device until seller APIs are connected.
Seller.listingsSub: Create and update retail products. Prices are easy to change — as required for Solangi.
Seller.priceNote: Catalog supports frequent price updates — edit anytime.
Seller.ordersSub: Incoming retail orders for your store (demo seed data).
Seller.ordersDemoNote: UI-only orders until checkout is live.
Seller.shopHint: Active listings with stock show on the homepage and category pages.

Cart.title: Your cart
Cart.sub: Review items, then checkout with Cash on Delivery.
Cart.shippingNote: Shipping is calculated at delivery for COD orders in this MVP.
Cart.checkoutSub: Confirm delivery address and pay with COD. Card, JazzCash, EasyPaisa, and bank marks stay offline until gateways are live.
Cart.paymentNote: Only COD is enabled in this module.
Cart.needAddress: Select or add a delivery address.
Cart.codOnly: Only Cash on Delivery is available right now.
Cart.codConfirm: You will pay cash when the order is delivered.
Cart.successBody: Your COD order is recorded on this device for portal review. Live payments come later.

Admin.loginSide: Demo admin gate for Solangi operators. OTP still uses the same local verify flow until real auth lands.
Admin.loginHint: Use any valid mobile — after OTP you land in the admin panel.
Admin.dashSub: Upload photos, review catalog coverage, and monitor COD orders. Data stays on this browser until a backend is connected.
Admin.cardOrdersBody: COD orders saved on this device
Admin.demoNote: Admin media is stored in localStorage for local testing. Replace with Hostinger/DB uploads before production.
Admin.mediaSub: Upload temporary images for hero slides and categories. Keep files under ~1.5MB for local storage.
Admin.fileTooLarge: Image is too large for local demo storage. Please use a file under 1.5MB.
Admin.catalogSub: Attach a photo per seed product. Icons remain until a photo is set.
Admin.ordersSub: COD orders placed from this browser session.
Admin.ordersEmpty: No orders yet — place a COD checkout from the shop to see it here.
Admin.logoNote: Solangi seal with gold trust spark — used in header, footer, and auth.
Admin.announcePh: Leave blank to use the default marketing strip
Admin.resetBody: Clears all uploaded hero, category, and product photos plus the custom announcement.
Admin.resetConfirm: Clear all admin media on this device?

ModeShop.empty: No listings in this filter yet.
ModeShop.note: Mode catalogs are demo seed data for local review. Live seller/mode moderation comes with the backend.
ModeShop.retailBlurb: Everyday shopping for customers — the full retail catalog.
ModeShop.wholesaleBlurb: Bulk lots and MOQ pricing for shops and businesses (B2B).
ModeShop.servicesBlurb: Book trusted local experts and service pros (C2B).
